  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Prepare the {{ing_01|meat}}: clean the {{ing_01|meat}}, scrape it as thin as a skin and shape it."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Crush {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}}, {{ing_04|cumin}}, {{ing_05|carraway}}, {{ing_06|silphium}}, {{ing_07|one laurel berry}}, moistened with {{ing_08|broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "In a square dish place the {{ing_01|meat balls}} and the spices where they remain in pickling for two or three days, covered crosswise with twigs."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Then place them in the oven [to be roasted]."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "When done take the finished {{ing_01|meat balls}} out."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Crush {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}}, with the {{ing_08|broth}}, add a little {{ing_09|raisin wine}} to sweeten."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Cook it, thicken with {{ing_10|roux}}, immerse the {{ing_01|balls}} in the sauce and serve."
    }
